title: Guided tour of Guell Park with Martha
text: Guell Park is a must-see in Barcelona. We took a guided tour with Martha who taught us a lot about the history of this park! She is very friendly and attentive to visitors. Even in the rain we had a pleasant time during our visit alongside Martha. Thanks to her!
author: fionadS2654UP

title: Silvia-the best tour guide in beautiful Barcelona.
text: Silvia, our tour guide, was amazing. We were late at the meeting point. Then we could’t enter the park alone, but she was so kind, came and looked for us and we entered the park together. My son said to me: “Mami, it shows how she loves Barcelona. Because she always says “my city”. Thank you, Silvia, for showing us a piece of your beautiful city 😊.

title: Very nice experience recommended

title: Great experience and great guide
text:
We did a group guided tour of the Park Güell. Our guide’s name was Clara, she did the whole tour in english and spanish, which was great as we are a bilingual couple. Carla was extremely well informed and provided us with interesting and fun facts about the city and its most famous architect. We would happily recommend anyone interested in culture and history to take the same tour and guide! 
Thanks!
author: Scenic660987

title: Great tour in English and Spanish
text: Clara gave us a great informative tour around Park Güell! She was able to give the tour both in English and Spanish to accommodate everyone on the tour. She was very fun and open to questions.
